clientTickets: SELECT id,ticket_number,issue_type,description,priority,status,created_at,updated_at FROM tickets WHERE lower(email)=lower($1) ORDER BY created_at DESC
clientQuotes: SELECT id,service_type,description,preferred_date,status,created_at,updated_at FROM quotes WHERE lower(email)=lower($1) ORDER BY created_at DESC
ownTicket: SELECT id,ticket_number FROM tickets WHERE id=$1 AND lower(email)=lower($2)
clientUpdates: SELECT id,body,created_by_email,created_at FROM ticket_updates WHERE ticket_id=$1 AND visible_to_client=true ORDER BY created_at ASC
notifyReply: INSERT INTO admin_notifications(type,title,body,entity_type,entity_id) VALUES('ticket_reply','Client replied to support ticket',$1,'ticket',$2)
